ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "UNDERREPRESENTED WIND BAND COMPOSERS." This course will use "The Horizon Leans Forward, Stories of Courage, Strength, and Triumph of Underrepresented Communities in the Wind Band Field" by Erik Leung; published by GIA. In addition to reading the book and (Zoom) visiting with some of the authors of the text, we will study and perform selected pieces of music that are included in the Annotated Bibliography of Wind Band Works by Underrepresented Composers. Tuesday will be a discussion day. Thursday will be a lab band day for students to conduct/rehearse pieces written by under-represented composers. Open to juniors, seniors and graduate students
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
